Attribution: `enhancement` is a level-4 leaf, so I reviewed only the 17 reachable commits tagged `jit:450db193`, individually with rename detection. Uncommitted changes were excluded. The prior missing-registry-source finding is resolved.

The generic projection documentation is otherwise accurate, but its canonical configuration reference has two issue-impact omissions.

1. **F1 — blocking, issue-impact, medium:** [`docs/reference/configuration.md:201`](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/configuration.md:201) does not state that `kind` is required. A projection without `kind` fails configuration parsing, and an empty list is rejected. Mark it required with at least one project-scoped kind; mirror this in [`docs/reference/example-config.toml:153`](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/example-config.toml:153).

2. **F2 — blocking, issue-impact, medium:** [`docs/reference/configuration.md:194`](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/configuration.md:194) describes every projection source as a “source registry” and instructs users to re-render after editing a registry. This is inaccurate for the issue’s new markdown-first capability. Refer to the canonical source (registry or markdown file) and instruct users to render after changing either; align [`docs/reference/example-config.toml:152`](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/example-config.toml:152).
